name: Furen Longbeard
summary: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, warriors seek Furen Longbeard's skill to forge specialized, battle-ready armor. Apprenticed to Grimand Elmore, the master armorer is known for his metallurgical expertise and heavy protective gear.

sections.title: A Dwarven Smith in the Human Capital
sections.body: Furen Longbeard works far from Ironforge's great forges, among the cobblestones and soot of Stormwind's Dwarven District. Like many dwarves, he brought traditional metallurgy south to help rebuild and defend the kingdom. His work keeps him connected with artisans throughout the city and beyond.

sections.title: Mastery of Fire-Hardened Mail
sections.body: Grimand Elmore taught Furen Longbeard his craft. Furen has perfected ways to treat heavy mail and plate so they can withstand the punishment of battle. Young warriors seeking durable protection turn to him, and he requires rare ores, specialized components, and exotic reagents from distant corners of the world to fashion his signature fire-hardened armor.

faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a dwarven armorer in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Alliance warriors seek him as an essential contact and mentor when they need mastercrafted mail armor.

faq.q: Where can Furen Longbeard be found?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard can be found in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, near the neighborhood's forges and smithing workshops.

faq.q: Who taught Furen his smithing craft?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore, a respected veteran craftsman who also lives in the Dwarven District, taught Furen Longbeard armorcraft and metallurgy.

faq.q: What armor is Furen famous for crafting?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is known for crafting Fire Hardened Mail, resilient armor made through exacting metallurgical work with rare components gathered across the continent.

faq.q: Is Furen Longbeard related to other Longbeards?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard shares his clan name with other prominent dwarves across the Eastern Kingdoms, including Pilot Longbeard, an Ironforge siege engine pilot. Furen focuses on smithing.

faq.q: Why do warriors seek out Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Warriors who have proven their basic martial prowess are directed to Furen Longbeard for heavy, durable armor that can endure front-line combat against deadlier threats.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you can turn to Furen Longbeard for fire-hardened armor made from gathered reagents and his smithing skill.
As a blacksmith, you can see the high standards of dwarven smithing in Stormwind and the advanced techniques Grimand Elmore passed down to Furen Longbeard.
As a dwarf, you can see Furen Longbeard keeping dwarven metallurgical traditions alive in the heart of the human capital.
